verdict.rationale: Trace Explorer lets you aggregate span data and filter or visualize span attributes with flexible queries, and the Issues page filters on properties like impacted users. However, nothing in the evidence says you can group by high-cardinality fields such as user id or request id without pre-aggregation or index setup. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of group-by on high-cardinality fields (user id, request id), confirmation that no pre-aggregation or index/schema definition is needed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
